description: Cloud-based customer support software and ticketing platform by Freshworks
auth_notes: API key authentication via HTTP basic auth (apikey:X or Base64 encoded) and OAuth 2.0 scopes for public apps.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a 14-day free trial (which starts on the Enterprise plan) to get API credentials/keys via profile settings.
api_notes: Comprehensive REST API v2 covering tickets, conversations, contacts, companies, agents, automation rules, business hours, and custom objects.
mcp_notes: Freshdesk publishes an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server integration to connect Freshdesk with AI tools and apps.
rationale: Freshdesk provides a fully documented REST API and official MCP support, accessible via a standard 14-day trial or paid subscription.

evidence.note: Details API key authentication, HTTP basic auth usage, and OAuth 2.0 scopes.
Explains how agents find their API key in profile settings after login/verification.
